title: Energy Balance and the Greenhouse Effect
summary: Solar radiation, uneven heating, albedo, the natural greenhouse effect and its enhancement.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 13: Earth as a System: Energy, Matter and Life

objectives: I can explain why Earth has a steady average temperature.
I can explain albedo and uneven heating.
I can distinguish the natural and enhanced greenhouse effect.
misconceptions: The greenhouse effect is entirely bad.
The poles are colder because they are further from the Sun.
